channel.title: FMCG & consumer · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on FMCG & consumer in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.1).

item.title: [+1] US and India 'as close as you can be' to a trade deal after Mumbai talks; a few items left
item.description:
The US Secretary of State urged India to buy more US and Venezuelan fuel and called India a 'refining superpower'. No deal was signed. A trilateral meeting with the UAE covered energy security. Escalating progress.

FMCG & consumer: mild tailwind (+1) — Textile and goods exports

Why it matters: A signed deal would cut the 18% US tariff on most Indian goods, helping exporters; more US and Venezuelan crude would diversify supply away from the Gulf.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] EU seeks a Black Sea shipping deal with Türkiye and India as NATO adds patrols after deadly attacks
item.description:
NATO is sending more patrol planes and drones; the EU is unlikely to send a naval mission. Ukraine wants a flag-based corridor. New diplomatic push.

FMCG & consumer: mild tailwind (+1) — Edible oil relief

Why it matters: A protected corridor would ease grain, sunflower oil and fertiliser supply, lowering food import costs for India.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
